activity-s127.condition: Spotlight on Russia «School life», с. 127. Твой любимый школьный предмет.
steps: My favourite school subject is literature. I like reading. At the lessons we learn about famous writers, read stories and learn poems.

discuss-s127.condition: Spotlight on Russia «School life», с. 127. Обсуди: школа в России и Британии.
steps: In my school we also have history, maths, Russian and literature. Children in the UK start school at 5, in Russia at 6–7. Our classes start at 8.30.

activity-s128.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Our country», с. 128. Заполни таблицу о республиках и напиши о народе.
steps: Chuvash Republic: on the Volga, capital Cheboksary, 1.2 million people, Chuvash and Russians. Tatarstan: capital Kazan, 4 million people, Tatars and Russians. The Tatars have their own language and traditional food — echpochmak.

activity-s129.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Homes», с. 129. Расскажи другу из Англии об избе.
steps: An izba is a small wooden country house. It has one or two rooms and a big stove. There is a «red corner» with a table and the family icon. Typical izbas have carved wooden windows.
activity-s129.answer: izba — wooden house, stove, red corner

activity-s130.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Hobbies», с. 130. Перескажи сказку по картинкам; расскажи о любимой сказке.
steps: The old man asks his wife to bake Kolobok. She puts it on the windowsill to cool. Kolobok runs away. He meets a hare, a wolf, a bear and sings his song. Then the fox eats him.

discuss-s130.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Hobbies», с. 130. Знаешь ли ты эту версию «Снегурочки»? Твоё хобби.
steps: Yes, I know this version of the tale. My hobby is swimming. I like spending time in the pool. I'd like to become a good swimmer.

activity-s131.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Animals», с. 131. Любимое животное.
steps: My favourite animal is the cat. Cats look like little lions. They are graceful. They can be fluffy or short-haired. Cats are clever and independent.

discuss-s131.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Animals», с. 131. Нравятся ли медведи? Сказки о животных? Дикие животные твоего региона?
steps: Yes, I like bears and other wild animals. Folk tales: Teremok, Kolobok, Masha and the Bear. In my region we can see deer, foxes, hares and wild boars.
discuss-s131.answer: bears; Teremok, Kolobok; deer, fox, hare

activity-s132.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Family time», с. 132. Как ты любишь проводить время с семьёй?
steps: I have a big family. We like to spend time together. We love playing board games like Alias. At weekends we go to the park or watch films together.

discuss-s132.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Family time», с. 132. Что делаете с семьёй по сезонам?
steps: Most of all I like playing Monopoly with my family. In summer we go camping. In spring we visit parks, in autumn we go to museums. In winter we go ice skating.
discuss-s132.answer: summer — camping, spring — parks, autumn — museums, winter — skating

activity-s133.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Seasons», с. 133. Любимое время года.
steps: My favourite season is summer because my birthday is in June. The sun shines brightly and we can swim in the warm sea. In summer I like riding my bike.

discuss-s133.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Seasons», с. 133. Климат твоего региона; что любишь делать по сезонам.
steps: The climate in my region is moderate. In summer I go to the sea and play outside. In spring I ride a bike. In autumn I take photos of nature. In winter I ski.
discuss-s133.answer: moderate climate; summer — sea, spring — bike, winter — ski

activity-s134.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Festivals», с. 134. Расскажи о празднике в России.
steps: Victory Day is an important holiday in Russia. It is celebrated on 9 May. People go to parades, watch fireworks and give flowers to veterans.
activity-s134.answer: Victory Day — 9 May, parades, fireworks, veterans

discuss-s134.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Festivals», с. 134. Как празднуют Масленицу в твоём городе?
steps: People sing songs, play games and eat hot pancakes with tea. At the end they burn a straw doll. Yes, I like Maslenitsa because everyone has fun together.

activity-s135.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Museums», с. 135. Музеи твоего региона.
steps: I live in Moscow. There are many museums: the Museum of Cosmonautics, the Paleontological Museum, the Tretyakov Gallery. My favourite is the Museum of Cosmonautics — you can see real spaceships there.

discuss-s135.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Museums», с. 135. Музей игрушек в прошлую пятницу; школьные экскурсии; что узнаёшь в музее.
steps: Yes, I liked the visit. I saw a lot of old toys. I often go on school trips — last time to the history museum. In museums we learn about culture and history.
discuss-s135.answer: toy museum; history museum; culture and history

activity-s136.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Holidays», с. 136. Расскажи о летнем лагере.
steps: Most of all I liked the camp in Crimea. It was by the sea. We had outdoor activities and sports games, slept in tents and learnt to make a fire.
activity-s136.answer: camp in Crimea — sea, sports, tents

discuss-s136.condition: Spotlight on Russia «Holidays», с. 136. Любят ли друзья лагеря? Что на картинках?
steps: Yes, my friends went to a summer camp in Crimea and liked it. In the first picture we see a disco. In the second and third pictures children are swimming.
